worldcombat.skill.psychic.summary: Seize the target with telekinesis: root it in place and drag it toward you, dealing special damage on the grab and possibly lowering its Sp. Def by 1 stage; a moment later, if it is still held, crush it again.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.use.0: Pick out one high-threat target at mid range
worldcombat.skill.psychic.use.1: Pin a charging enemy in place
worldcombat.skill.psychic.use.2: Drag a target away from an ally
worldcombat.skill.psychic.description.0: The grab deals %1$s special damage, and if the target is still held it takes another %2$s a moment later.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.description.1: The grip roots the target for %1$s and drags it %2$s blocks toward you (bigger bodies resist); the second crush lands after %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.description.2: On the grab it has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.psychic.hold.on: Coiling grip: longer root, heavier crush, longer drag and a more reliable Sp. Def drop, at the cost of slightly lighter grab, shorter reach and longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.hold.off: Point grip: a longer, faster, heavier grab, at the cost of a shorter root, a lighter crush and a rarer Sp. Def drop.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.growth.0: From level %1$s the grab rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.growth.1: From level %1$s the grab rises to %2$s power and %3$s Sp. Def drop chance.
worldcombat.skill.psychic.preference.hol: On: root x1.5, crush x1.25, drag x1.2, Sp. Def drop x1.3, but grab x0.94, reach x0.85, +3 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown — hold a target down longer. Off (point grip): a longer, faster, heavier grab, at the cost of a shorter root, a lighter crush and a rarer Sp. Def drop.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in before focusing; larger values let it open from further away.
On: targets already rooted or asleep are ranked last, saving the grip for a foe that can still move. Off: all targets are equal.
On: targets attacking the companion or its owner rank higher — pin and drag the most dangerous one. Off: ordinary ranged ordering.
